name: Average Teaching Dimension
definition: The **average teaching dimension** of a finite class $\mathcal H$ is the average, over $h\in\mathcal H$, of the minimum size of a teaching set for $h$ within $\mathcal H$: $\mathrm{TS}_{\mathrm{avg}}(\mathcal H)=|\mathcal H|^{-1}\sum_{h\in\mathcal H}\mathrm{TS}(h;\mathcal H)$.
graph_summary: Mean, over concepts, of their minimum teaching-set sizes.
description: The average-case counterpart of teaching dimension.
